name: 5-chloro-DMT
summary: 5-Chloro-DMT, or 5-Cl-DMT, also known as 5-chloro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and other psychedelic tryptamines such as 5-bromo-DMT and 5-fluoro-DMT. It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

pharmacology.text: 5-Chloro-DMT acts as a serotonin receptor agonist. It is known to have affinity for and act as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, and 5-HT2C receptors. The drug shows higher affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor compared to unsubstituted dimethyltryptamine (DMT), with around 10-fold higher selectivity for this receptor over the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is one of a set of DMT analogues carrying a halogen atom at the 5 position. Chlorine, bromine and fluorine all fit there, and each shifts which serotonin receptors the drug prefers.
fact.zh: 它屬於一組在第5位帶有鹵素原子的DMT類似物。氯、溴與氟都能接在那個位置，而每一種都會改變藥物偏好哪些血清素受體。
fact.zhHans: 它属于一组在第5位带有卤素原子的DMT类似物。氯、溴与氟都能接在那个位置，而每一种都会改变药物偏好哪些血清素受体。
